description: Editable risk rules for the vuln-scan-report tool (synthetic lab use).

service_rules.title: Telnet service exposed
service_rules.remediation: Disable Telnet; use SSH instead. Block TCP/23 at the firewall.

service_rules.title: Anonymous FTP login allowed
service_rules.remediation: Disable anonymous FTP; require authenticated SFTP/FTPS and restrict shares.

service_rules.title: SMB message signing not required
service_rules.remediation: Require SMB signing via GPO (Microsoft network server/client: Digitally sign communications).

service_rules.title: Possible SMBv1 / legacy SMB exposure
service_rules.remediation: Disable SMBv1 organization-wide; prefer SMB 2.1+/3.x only.

service_rules.title: RDP exposed on the network
service_rules.remediation: Restrict RDP to jump hosts/VPN; enforce NLA and strong auth; consider RD Gateway.

service_rules.title: SNMP service exposed
service_rules.remediation: Use SNMPv3 with authPriv; restrict source IPs; never leave community strings as public/private.

service_rules.title: HTTP admin / login page on plaintext HTTP
service_rules.remediation: Serve admin UIs over HTTPS only; restrict management interfaces to a secured VLAN.

service_rules.title: Outdated OpenSSH version
service_rules.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to a currently supported release and disable weak algorithms.

service_rules.title: Weak TLS/SSL ciphers or protocols
service_rules.remediation: Disable SSLv3/TLS 1.0/1.1; allow only strong TLS 1.2+ cipher suites (AEAD).

service_rules.title: MySQL exposed to the network
service_rules.remediation: Bind MySQL to localhost or a private DB VLAN; require TLS and strong auth.
